newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MOTOR RACING-PORTUGAL DENY GRAND PRIX CANCELLED.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-PORTUGAL DENY GRAND PRIX CANCELLED.

text.p: Portugal's Economy Minister denied on Thursday that Estoril had lost its season-ending grand prix.
He said the Formula One race had only been delayed two weeks to give time for repairs to the circuit.

Augusto Mateus said that the government would bankroll $6 million of improvements demanded by the International Automobile Federation (FIA) to ensure the race could be staged on its new date of November 9.
"The definitive date for the (Portuguese) grand prix has been agreed with FIA for November 9, which will be the last grand prix of the season," Mateus said.
Earlier, the FIA had announced that the race, scheduled for October 26 had been cancelled and switched to Spain's Jerez track where it would be re-named the European Grand Prix.

But Portuguese Automobile Club chairman Alfredo Cesar Torres, a FIA vice-president, said Mateus had received a fax from FIA president Max Mosley confirming the November 9 race for Estoril and setting up a meeting for next week to finalise details.
"The government accepts the challenge and will put every effort into completing the necessary work in time to satisfy the FIA," Mateus said.
The improvements include alterations to the paddock and various spectator facilities as well as enhanced run-off areas.
